name: pixel-office
description: Shows your Claude Code sessions as little people in a self-hosted pixel-art office. Sends hook events to your pixel-office server; costs the model zero tokens.

server_url.title: pixel-office server URL(s)
server_url.description: Where your pixel-office server runs, e.g. https://office.example.com or http://127.0.0.1:8790. Several offices (e.g. home and work): separate them with commas.

token.title: Ingest token(s)
token.description: Your token for the office (from 👥 People, or `pixel-office token` on the server). Several offices: their tokens, comma separated, in the same order as the URLs.
